units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: You created this train?!
You own the train??

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: Who the heck are you? Don’t talk to me.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(Ah… ignoring that…)</style> They certainly didn’t talk about you in my interview!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: My involvement isn’t well known, civilian.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: The infrastructure in your towns just wasn’t cutting it. If I were to build Eggmanland, these problems would need sorting out!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: So, I courageously got involved!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: I converted some cargo trains into passenger trains for the sake of the public… it’s just more useful for future schemes.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.sourceText: Let me guess… Another death egg, Doctor Predictable?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: The people fear giant spheres! It’s science!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.sourceText: Let’s cut to the chase. Where are our friends?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: Judging by my security cameras, your pathetic friends are all locked in the cars they were stationed in.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: Seems you managed to make the train quite upset.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.sourceText: …? Did you not know this was happening?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: Heavens no, I’m only now getting caught up. I’m far too busy to notice what a passenger train is up to.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: You see, the capability of a badnik is normally very basic, just kill Sonic The Hedgehog.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: But for a luxury train, I wanted to be sure things ran without my supervision. And report to me if any of you happened aboard.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: This train’s capability of intellectual thought is extraordinary! A feat only accomplished by my genius!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(So this confirms it… the train really is sentient.)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: Suffice to say, your capture is inevitable. You’re on a train that desires nothing more than to deliver you all to me.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: See I got to thinking… I needed to manufacture motivation beyond programming.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: I like to make my badniks compete against one another from time to time. It’s good for productivity.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: So I instituted a <style=Important>bounty</style> upon my army of badniks!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: First to capture you pathetic creatures gets <style=Important>a generous reward</style>!
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Barry
units.sourceText: <style=Thought>(The train wants to deliver us to Eggman… for <style=Important>a reward</style>?)</style>
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: Most of my robots ask for something simple like my autograph or whatever, but a highly intelligent train…
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: It may ask for something more… interesting.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.sourceText: As much as I like reward programs, are you done blabbering, Doc?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.sourceText: You can never just win silently, can you?
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: When you’re dragged to my base you’ll regret the day you ever crossed me, hedgehog.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.sourceText: I already do. Get lost.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Eggman
units.sourceText: Eheheheh… ciao.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.sourceText: …he always knows how to get under my skin.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.sourceText: This is tough… the train has the motivation, and being made by Eggman, it’s no doubt powerful.
units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.speaker: Sonic
units.sourceText: Not to mention, we’re all separated…

units.sourceText: But when negative thoughts hit you, let it pass, and keep living.

units.note: Translate dialogue body only; the speaker key is runtime control data.

units.sourceText: Library Map
An overhead map of the layout of the Library, shelves and tables included.
Blowdart
A blowdart found on the floor in the conductor’s car. No dart board nearby though… suspicious.
Amy's Hammer
Amy's trusty hammer! It's great for all kinds of things from punting Eggman to mounting picture frames.
Camera
My special little boy
Shadow's Lock
A lock that supposedly Shadow has been placing on multiple doors of the train.
Train Map
A map of the train!
Smashed Arcade
A Super Monkey Ball arcade machine completely smashed up. It's a shame to see Super Monkey Ball in this state.
Train Map
A map of the train!
Keyring
Shadow’s keyring with two dangling keys. I always thought a locksmith would have more keys than that.
Used Cups
Used cups sitting on the Saloon Car’s bar. One cup has a lipstick mark on the rim.
Train Map
A map of the train!
Mirage Express Manual
An exhaustive manual of the Mirage Express’ many features and capabilities. Doesn’t seem to mention how to drive the train, which would've been neat.
Train Map
A map of the train!
Stick
Some sort of stick. On closer inspection, could it also be a handle?
Train Map
A map of the train!
Train Map
A map of the train!
Lost Ticket
So sad to see a ticket alone and confused like this… We’ll return it, I have faith.
Menu
The Mirage Express dining menu. It features ‘chili dog‘, ‘instant ramen’ and ‘chicken cordon bleu.’
Broken Robot Arm
The cord to a robotic arm is completely sliced through. I humored the idea of an ax causing this, but weapons aren’t allowed on the train.
Train Map
A map of the train!
Crack on Shelf
A large chunk of a bookcase is missing. Odd.
Hidden Passage
Pulling a string in the wardrobe revealed a hidden passage! Upon inspection, it leads from the lounge to the library.
Train Map
A map of the train!
Blueprints
Blueprints showcasing the full layout and specifications of each car on the train, including the hidden passage. A code to the safe is handwritten in the corner.
Crumpled Paper
Ball of paper found in the trash bin… I kinda want to see what it is.
Train Map
A map of the train!
